test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.

They have decided / to wind out / their business / without delay.
solution:
The segment that contains an error is ‘4’ i.e. to wind out.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"to wind out"** is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"to wind up,**" which means to bring an activity or business to an end.
 
• The corrected sentence should read “They have decided to wind up their business without delay.”

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *They have decided to wind up their business without delay.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**, "They have decided," is grammatically correct.
 
• **Option 2**, "their business," is grammatically correct and contextually appropriate.
 
• **Option 3**, "without delay," is also correct.
 
• Using the correct phrasal verbs ensures clarity and precision in communication.
